from PIL import Image
def show(f, W=120, H=40):
    im = Image.open('/home/robot/captures/'+f+'.jpg').convert('L')

        if hi is None and c>=tot*0.95: hi=i
    lo=lo or 0; hi=hi or 255
    if hi<=lo: hi=lo+1
    im2 = im.point(lambda v: 0 if v<lo else (255 if v>hi else (v-lo)*255//(hi-lo)))

    px = im2.load()
    chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
    print('=====',f)
    for y in range(H):
        print(''.join(chars[px[x,y]*len(chars)//256] for x in range(W)))
show('overview_002')

def show(f, W=150, H=50, lo_p=0.5, hi_p=99.5):
    im = Image.open('/home/robot/captures/'+f+'.jpg').convert('L')
    hist = im.histogram()
    tot=sum(hist); c=0; lo=None; hi=None

    im2 = im.point(lambda v: 0 if v<lo else (255 if v>hi else (v-lo)*255//(hi-lo)))

    px = im2.load()
    chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
    print('=====',f)
    for y in range(H):
        print(''.join(chars[px[x,y]*len(chars)//256] for x in range(W)))
show('door_001')
